::: {.callout-tip}
**Everything on this site (this homepage included) is built with Quarto.**
This website is itself a Quarto artefact: the *pages you browse* are Quarto
documents rendered to HTML, and **every one of the six slide decks is also a
Quarto document**, written in the same plain-markdown-plus-code syntax and
rendered to reveal.js slides. Quarto is one tool that produces websites, slide
decks and books from a single source; the *Reproducible Workflows* course below
teaches exactly that.
:::

This repository collects teaching material for two graduate courses (ENSAI /
Nantes Université, taught by A. Stamm). Each course is three 3-hour sessions;
the slide decks point to hands-on labs and live-coding, which fill out the
time.

## The R Statistical Language {#course-base-r}

An **introductory / comprehensive** course on R, taught from the base-R console
in Positron and progressively moving into the tidyverse and ggplot2. The
[course home page](r-statistical-language/index.qmd) gathers the synopsis,
the slides per session, the hands-on labs and the learning outcomes.

::: {.callout-note}

deck, you can return to its course home page at any time by clicking the
logo in the top-left corner of any slide.
:::

## Why a website? {#why-a-website}

Quarto can render one source into many output shapes. The same project that
produces these six **revealjs slide decks** and (in the RR course) a **Quarto
book** also renders this **website**, an ordinary Quarto site whose pages link
straight to the decks. In other words: **yes, all the slides were also made
with Quarto**, and so was the site that hosts them.
